item.title: WATCH LIVE: NASA's newest space telescope launches today
item.description: The tour-bus-sized telescope aims to unravel cosmic mysteries and identify more than 100,000 planets beyond our solar system.

item.title: The U.S. relied on these science advisers. Then the Trump administration cut them
item.description: The federal government recruits top experts to volunteer to advise on pressing research issues of the day. Since President Trump took office, hundreds of these experts have been dismissed.

item.title: Scientists collaborated with narwhals to study warming waters in the Arctic
item.description: Scientists collaborated with narwhals for a new study to understand human-caused climate change in the Arctic and rising sea levels around the world.

item.title: New Jersey is a fossil hotspot, with answers about the day the dinosaurs died
item.description: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Edelman Fossil Park & Museum of Rowan University)
